rationale: The self-review identified that the executive brief's 8 numeric statements lack source citations, reducing traceability and credibility for executive-level decision-making. Setting brief_sections cite_artifacts to true ensures every metric includes a [source: path] reference, maintaining transparency about data provenance. The prior plan's structure—collecting findings from T2 (portfolio), T4 (denial patterns), and T7 (high-cost model), organizing sections to include synthetic_caveats, and applying standard caveats to the report—remains sound and addresses all feedback to date.
changes_summary: Set brief_sections cite_artifacts parameter to true (was false) to address self-review finding: all 8 numeric statements in the executive brief now include [source: path] citations for traceability and credibility of denial rates, fraud prevalence, and model performance scores.
